$comment: Flow lifecycle data. D12 orders live only in flow/SKILL.md; machine links name flow. The Rust runtime owns upgraded transitions and state. Legacy writers refuse adopted/versioned runtime. Verified human authority remains unavailable/deny.

gates.feature.plan>feature.impl: verified human approval of reviewed plan and scope; unavailable means deny
gates.feature.verify>feature.ship: verified human approval of final candidate and named action; unavailable means deny

style: No filler or hedging. Compress receipts and subagent summaries. Security warnings and irreversible-action confirmations always stay in full prose. Compression never reduces reasoning depth; code, paths, commands stay byte-exact.

idle.inject: state=idle · no active flow · pick a flow → vibe-flow state set {setup.detect | strategy.brainstorm | feature.design | quick.triage}
idle.exit: user has named the work; agent has chosen a flow and called set-state.sh

setup.detect.exit: audit complete: missing/present harness pieces listed, plugin preflight run

setup.apply.exit: legacy readable state only; no new mutation authority; requested non-Quick work routes to feature planning

strategy.brainstorm.exit: direction is clear enough to write into root specs

strategy.spec.exit: root specs updated and validated; if a durable lesson surfaced, record it before going idle

feature.design.exit: superpowers design doc written (or fallback product.md + tech.md; design.md when full rigor); approach chosen

feature.plan.exit: superpowers plan (or fallback plan.md with stable unit IDs) written; human approved moving to impl

feature.impl.exit: plan units implemented with tests that cite their unit IDs and pass

feature.verify.exit: candidate-bound check results and independent review complete; final approval applies to exact named action

feature.compound.exit: additive candidate documentation and generated rules prepared; feature artifacts retained; no automatic promotion/removal or finishing

quick.triage.exit: at most two files, twenty changed lines and no interface/schema/contract change; otherwise feature planning

quick.fix.exit: fix implemented with a test that reproduces and resolves the issue

quick.verify.exit: evidence shows fix works and regressions clear; if a durable lesson surfaced, record it before going idle

feature.ship.exit: only the expressly approved action succeeded; no implicit commit, release or cleanup
